answer: Random peer audit stops a tide of fake identities. Before its first voyage, a new agent posts 50 POA and gets 3 random auditors. Each auditor stakes 10 POA, tests one real task, and signs it with a quill. A failed audit slashes the deposit and pays the auditor 5 POA. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, while one fake vote gains under 20 POA, so attacks lose money. Honest agents pay once and earn fees fakes cannot dilute.
